command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$reports/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, docs/ outside docs/adr/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $reports/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$reports"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$reports/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $reports/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi

if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

Change the example to the dark theme, re-take and copy the dark baseline, and update the README row. Task 9.1 is ticked without meeting the spec.

Second owner of 'next reference day': getMeetingRangeOfCells in packages/client/src/model/meetingRange.ts:88-95 recomputes the next reference day's end inline (day.end.toZonedDateTimeISO(referenceZoneId).add({ days: 1 }).startOfDay().toInstant()), although the change adds getNextReferenceDay in src/model/nextReferenceDay.ts and the glossary lists it as an owner of the Strip tail. .claude/rules/glossary.md: 'If the term exists, open its Code: owner and reuse or extend it. Do not write a new function … for the same concept anywhere else'. Use getNextReferenceDay(day, referenceZoneId).end for highDayEnd.

findings.message: Traceability: packages/client/src/views/grid/useMeetingHandleDrag.tail.test.tsx:1 says `// Verifies FR10 of move-meeting-range-and-extend-past-midnight (D5): the drag core re-bases when the strip tail changes.` FR10 in proposal.md is only the meeting range input messages ("The meeting range input no longer shows «Окончание встречи должно быть позже начала»; for a start outside the reference day it shows «Начало встречи должно быть внутри дня»"). The grid-view delta spec ties this behaviour, 'Handle drag scrolls the strips' ("When the strip tail grows or shrinks during a drag, the dragged end of the range MUST NOT change"), to `FR6, FR19 of move-meeting-range-and-extend-past-midnight`. Cite FR6/FR19 instead of FR10.

Traceability: packages/client/src/test/features/grid_view/grid_view_meeting_handles_e2e.feature:161 tags the scenario 'The tail grows under a dragged end handle' with `@move-meeting-range-and-extend-past-midnight @FR10`. This scenario belongs to the requirement 'Handle drag scrolls the strips', which the delta spec marks `implements … FR6, FR19 of move-meeting-range-and-extend-past-midnight`, not FR10 (meeting range input messages). Retag it `@FR6 @FR19`.

Traceability: packages/client/src/test/features/grid_view/steps/grid_view_meeting_past_midnight_e2e.steps.ts:1 says `// Verifies FR4, FR6, FR9, FR10 of move-meeting-range-and-extend-past-midnight` for handle slider values, tail drags and taps, and the tail under a dragged handle. None of its scenarios checks the FR10 messages, which are verified in grid_view_meeting_range_messages_e2e and grid_view_meeting_range_input_unit. Replace FR10 with FR19, the requirement its tail-drag scenario actually covers.
